sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT (the light from above)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 30 %, drive forward; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line; in a dark tunnel with no line, drive straight through without touching its walls; then follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the light sensor LLIGHT reads below 30 %

branches.reason: In the simulator a tunnel is never darker than 40 %, so the light sensors never read below 30 %.
branches.outcome: the light is below 30 %: it drives straight forward
the light is 30 % or more: it goes on to stopAtWall
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle: it goes on to followLine

input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line

equivalence_classes: a line runs on under the roof
input_dimensions.dimension: what the line tracker sees inside the tunnel
what the line tracker sees after the exit
what is in front of the robot in bright light

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it takes stopAtWall, sees no obstacle, and in followLine curves left on black and right on the floor; since the light never falls below 30 %, under the roof it keeps curving right when it sees no line.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line in bright light that runs on into a tunnel; in dim light nothing is in front of the robot.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black and the floor again and again; then, under the roof, it stops seeing a line.
scenarios.title: Follows the line, through the dark tunnel and on again
assumptions: The line's end is where it should get to.
'No line in the tunnel' means the line stops under the roof.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to the tunnel, drives straight through the dark without touching the tunnel's walls, and follows the line again after the tunnel.

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the obstacle is ahead.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line in bright light, with an obstacle across the line ahead.
scenarios.trigger: The obstacle sensor sees the obstacle.
scenarios.title: Stops at an obstacle in the light

uncertainties: The light-below-30 % branch can never happen: a tunnel reads at darkest 40 %, so in the dark the robot still curves right when it sees no line, and that may take it into a tunnel wall.
You didn't say what the robot should do when something is in front of it in the light, so that situation has no expected behaviour.
You didn't say where the line ends, so the tests take the end of the line as the goal.
A right program may not find the line again after the dark, so following the line after the tunnel can't be tested reliably.
